# BCGov Crow - v0.15.3

## Release type

Patch release: compatible modules and routing added to existing skills; no
new skill or agent.

## Summary

Integrated stateful business-logic review into Crow's existing architecture,
development, security-review, code-review, and testing workflows. Supersedes
the standalone-skill approach proposed in bcgov/crow#76 and bcgov/crow#77.

## Highlights

- Source and verify lifecycle, transaction, conserved-value, concurrency,
  tenant, replay, distributed-state, and tool-authority invariants across
  alternate entry points.
- Challenge suspected failures against actual database constraints, atomic
  writes, isolation, policy enforcement, and rollback behavior.
- Keep uncertain and refuted hypotheses outside confirmed vulnerability
  counts and retain the existing `SEC-NNN` report and synthesis contract.
- Route development and testing to isolated concurrency, replay, authorization,
  and failure-path checks when the affected application has those boundaries.

## Scope and verification

The proposed standalone skill, CodeQL packs, Semgrep rules, and evaluation
fixtures from #77 are not packaged: their rule engines and fixtures were not
validated for this patch. Manual inspection guidance covers all 13 proposed
invariant domains; automated rules may be integrated separately after
deterministic fixture verification.

Full-package, plugin and collection manifests are aligned at 0.15.3. Asset,
package and release checks are required before publication; final release
verification and checksums remain pending.
